doc: Elyms nighty (alt3; sleepwear). Clothes_nighty_1.png is the white cotton nightgown, Body_nighty_2.png holds large skin areas (45 % of the sheet), purple knit and the silver chest plate; Glass_nighty_glass.png is glass (gem class, blend); fur tiles are left to Remix. Its hair 2 is the nighty hair (a different hash from the default hair 2). Converted on 2026-11-03 from the game's own texture rips (Codex's port, nte15_gmod; zips in ipg\nte_15), without AABB, applied to the four ragdolls in the active session. The game has no roughness or metallic map: its toon shader reads T_*_n (a real normal map, used as the sheet's normal_map), T_*_m (LightMap: R spec intensity, B a flat specular-size class per material) and T_*_id (ramp and matcap selector; red 0 = skin), so scripts/ue_toon_maps.py derives roughness from _m.B and _m.R, skin (ID red 0) at the standard 0.70, and metallic from the strongest spec texels whose paint is bright silver or gold. The convert rules are an interpretation (see that script's header). The PMX names Body_1/Body_2 mean the main outfit sheet here, not skin: pinned to cloth. Face, eyes and hair keep the anime-safe and class values; hair sheets and tiny alpha-blend fur tiles were left out. Shared sheets (face, eyes, Hair_hair_1) are generated by one model only.
